SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Choose a bounded reach and one primary target. Distances and tackle needs depend on that decision; a river-wide species list cannot specify the best launch, depth or method. Compare guiding offers by the actual stretch covered and the time spent fishing.

Choose a reach and presentation

A river name is not a complete day plan. Decide the reach, bank access and presentation first. Ask for the useful lure weight or fly-line arrangement, then match the rod, reel and leader to that answer. Wading is a separate decision and is not assumed in this brief.

What is established—and what is not

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Ireland

A state licence is required for salmon and sea trout. Most waters also require permission or a fishery permit; the state licence does not provide access.

  • 1 dayEUR 36
  • 21 daysEUR 50
  • Calendar yearEUR 100
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Midland Fisheries permit ↗
    Anglers who fish trout, pike or coarse fish on Midland Fisheries controlled waters in the Shannon catchment. Buy the permit through Inland Fisheries Ireland’s permit service.

Rules for this water

  • The Midland Fisheries Group permit is not required on the main River Shannon; it applies to listed controlled tributaries and lakes.
  • Check the current pike and coarse-fish rules, and any private fishery permission, for the selected reach official regulations ↗
